ev.q: Surveillance data from 15 states during 2006--2010 identified 10 incidents of chemical suicides in automobiles
the small number of incidents identified by ATSDR complicates evaluation of chemical suicide trends
one in 2006, one in 2007, four in 2009, and four in 2010
Of the 10 incidents, nine occurred in residential areas
Seven of the 10 victims were male.
Of the 10 incidents, nine occurred in residential areas and four resulted in evacuation orders affecting 85 persons
using 2006--2009 data from states participating in the Hazardous Substances Emergency Events Surveillance (HSEES) system

methods_quotes.q: A case was defined as a suicide or attempted suicide using mixed chemicals in an automobile.
Case reports were read to confirm that the suicide took place inside an automobile and chemicals were mixed.
open text fields were queried in the comments and synopsis sections
